body.name: \(\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}}\)
body.def: Let \(\widehat\lambda_{\min}(c)=\lambda_{\min}(\widehat H_c)\) and set \(\widehat H_c^{\mathrm{tot}}=\widehat H_c+\{h/2-\widehat\lambda_{\min}(c)\}_+I_d\). This measurable ridge fallback has smallest eigenvalue at least \(h/2\) for every sample and every \(c\), and equals \(\widehat H_c\) whenever \(\widehat\lambda_{\min}(c)\ge h/2\).
